title: OpenRTB 2.6 Bid
description: An offer to buy a specific impression under certain business terms.

id.description: Bidder generated bid ID to assist with logging/tracking.

impid.description: ID of the Imp object in the related bid request.

price.description: Bid price expressed as CPM although the actual transaction is for a unit impression only.

nurl.description: Win notice URL called by the exchange if the bid wins.

burl.description: Billing notice URL called by the exchange when a winning bid becomes billable.

lurl.description: Loss notice URL called by the exchange when a bid is known to have been lost.

adm.description: Optional means of conveying ad markup in case the bid wins.

adid.description: ID of a preloaded ad to be served if the bid wins.

adomain.description: Advertiser domain for block list checking (e.g., "ford.com").

bundle.description: The store ID of the app in an app store.

iurl.description: URL without cache-busting to an image representative of the content of the campaign.

cid.description: Campaign ID to assist with ad quality checking.

crid.description: Creative ID to assist with ad quality checking.

tactic.description: Tactic ID to enable buyers to label bids for reporting to the exchange.

cattax.description: The taxonomy in use. Refer to AdCOM 1.0 List: Category Taxonomies.

cat.description: IAB Tech Lab content categories of the creative.

attr.description: Set of attributes describing the creative. Refer to AdCOM 1.0 List: Creative Attributes.

apis.description: List of supported APIs for the markup. Refer to AdCOM 1.0 List: API Frameworks.

protocol.description: Video response protocol of the markup if applicable.

qagmediarating.description: Creative media rating per IQG guidelines. Refer to AdCOM 1.0 List: Media Ratings.

language.description: Language of the creative using ISO-639-1-alpha-2.

langb.description: Language of the creative using IETF BCP 47.

dealid.description: Reference to the deal.id from the bid request if this bid pertains to a private marketplace direct deal.

w.description: Width of the creative in device-independent pixels (DIPS).

h.description: Height of the creative in device-independent pixels (DIPS).

wratio.description: Relative width of the creative when expressing size as a ratio. Required for Flex Ads.

hratio.description: Relative height of the creative when expressing size as a ratio. Required for Flex Ads.

exp.description: Advisory as to the number of seconds the bidder is willing to wait between auction and actual impression.

dur.description: Duration of the video or audio creative in seconds.

mtype.description: Type of the creative markup. 1 = Banner, 2 = Video, 3 = Audio, 4 = Native.

slotinpod.description: Indicates that the bid response is only eligible for a specific position within a video or audio ad pod.

ext.description: Placeholder for bidder-specific extensions to OpenRTB.

api.description: DEPRECATED. Use apis instead. API framework of the creative.
